text: I have been waiting since more than one hour on the phone line only, so kindly reply fast. My stepdaughter is 1 month old. Since evening her temperature is 38.4. I think she has some small red-purple dots on her tummy and legs, not sure exactly when they came. My wife pressed a glass on them like they show and they are not going, still the same colour. Also one eye is pink and sticky since morning itself, we were thinking that is just a small infection. Please tell what to do, whether we should take her somewhere now or not.
